format: Aseman OpenUI JSON tree: {"c":"ComponentName","p":{...props},"children":[...]} or type/openui wrapper

AppShell.signature: AppShell(children: any[], title?: string, subtitle?: string)
AppShell.description: Neutral root viewport — always root = AppShell([...]). Compose paradigm chrome (AppBar, Drawer, Hero, …) inside; optional title/subtitle only when no custom chrome

Page.signature: Page(children: any[], title?: string, subtitle?: string)
Page.description: Full page body under AppShell; title optional, children required

Section.signature: Section(title: string, children: any[], description?: string, glass?: boolean)
Section.description: Named content section with optional description and children

Container.description: Width-limited content wrapper; size sm|md|lg|full (default md); optional center

Center.description: Centers children horizontally (and optionally vertically in a min-height)

Stack.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Stack.description: Flex layout; direction row|column (default column), gap none–2xl, align/justify, wrap

Grid.description: CSS grid; columns count (default 2), gap none–2xl, children as cells

Split.description: Two-pane split; ratio "50"|"33"|"67" (left share), left and right child arrays

Sidebar.description: Sidebar + main content layout for desk navigation panels

Tabs.description: Tabbed views; pass TabItem refs — ideal for chart/table alternate views

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: any[])
TabItem.description: Single tab: value id, trigger label, content children

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(title: string, content: any[], defaultOpen?: boolean)
AccordionItem.description: Accordion panel with title and content children

Spacer.description: Flexible empty space; size xs–2xl or grow to fill remaining flex space

ScrollArea.description: Scrollable region with optional maxHeight in pixels

Frame.description: Content stage; children required; variant "plain"|"panel"|"bleed" (default plain); optional pad sm|md|lg

Overlay.description: Dimmed backdrop wrapping a Sheet or focused content (visual only in desk cards)

Sheet.description: Elevated panel/sheet for focused tasks; title optional, children required; side "center"|"end" (default center)

AppBar.signature: AppBar(title?: string, leading?: any[], actions?: any[], dense?: boolean)
AppBar.description: Top chrome bar for apps: optional leading children (menu/back), title, trailing action children

NavBar.description: Horizontal navigation of NavItem refs (site/app sections)

NavItem.signature: NavItem(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, active?: boolean, icon?: string)
NavItem.description: Nav / drawer / bottom-nav item; label, optional action, active highlight

Drawer.signature: Drawer(side: any[], main: any[], title?: string, variant?: "rail" | "panel")
Drawer.description: Side navigation + main stage; side children (NavItems/Menu), main children; variant "rail"|"panel" (default panel)

BottomNav.description: Bottom tab bar of BottomNavItem refs for compact/mobile app paradigms

BottomNavItem.signature: BottomNavItem(label: string, icon?: string, action?: ActionExpression, active?: boolean)
BottomNavItem.description: Bottom navigation destination; label, optional icon + action, active state

Masthead.description: Brand masthead: brand name + optional trailing NavItem/Button children

Hero.signature: Hero(headline: string, subcopy?: string, actions?: any[], media?: string, align?: "start" | "center")
Hero.description: Landing hero: headline, optional subcopy, CTA children, optional media/image URL; align start|center

Dock.description: Sticky bottom action dock; children usually ButtonGroup; optional leading note

BreadcrumbItem.description: Breadcrumb segment; label, optional action (omit action on current)

Segmented.description: Segmented control of Segment refs (view switcher)

Segment.signature: Segment(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, active?: boolean)
Segment.description: Segmented-control option; label, optional action, active

CommandBar.description: Dense action strip under AppBar; children usually Button/IconButton/Segmented

StatusBar.description: Footer status strip; leading text, optional trailing children

Pagination.signature: Pagination(page: number, pages: number, prev?: ActionExpression, next?: ActionExpression)
Pagination.description: Simple pager; page, pages, optional prev/next actions

Fab.signature: Fab(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, icon?: string)
Fab.description: Floating action button; label or icon string + action

WizardRail.description: Horizontal wizard step rail of WizardRailStep refs

WizardRailStep.description: Wizard rail step; label, state todo|current|done

Footer.signature: Footer(brand?: string, children?: any[], note?: string)
Footer.description: Page footer with optional brand, link children, and note

Card.signature: Card(children?: any[], title?: string, description?: string, media?: string, footer?: any[], tone?: "neutral" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info")
Card.description: Interactive or static surface card; optional title, description, media URL, footer children, tone

Tile.signature: Tile(label: string, value: string, hint?: string, tone?: "neutral" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info")
Tile.description: Compact metric/action tile; label, value, optional hint and tone

Quote.description: Block quote / testimonial; text, optional attribution

Figure.signature: Figure(src: string, caption?: string, alt?: string)
Figure.description: Figure with media URL and caption

Feature.signature: Feature(title: string, body?: string, icon?: string)
Feature.description: Feature bullet for landing/marketing; title, body, optional icon emoji

ProsCons.description: Two-column pros/cons lists from string arrays

LogoStrip.description: Row of brand/logo labels (strings) for social proof

Text.signature: Text(text: string, tone?: "primary" | "secondary" | "muted", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", mono?: boolean)
Text.description: Body copy; tone primary|secondary|muted, size sm|md|lg

Markdown.description: Lightweight markdown body (headings, bold, lists, code)

Callout.description: Highlighted notice; tone info|success|warning|danger|neutral, title, body

Avatar.description: User/tool avatar from initials or image URL; size sm|md|lg

AvatarGroup.description: Stacked initials/names from string array; optional max visible

Image.description: Image by URL with optional alt text

CodeBlock.description: Monospace code block; optional language label

JsonBlock.description: Pretty-printed JSON/text block for debug/API responses

EmptyState.description: Placeholder when a list/table/query has no data

Skeleton.description: Loading placeholder block; width/height as CSS strings (e.g. 100%, 16px)

Stat.signature: Stat(label: string, value: string, delta?: string, deltaTone?: "up" | "down" | "neutral", glass?: boolean)
Stat.description: Single KPI: label, value string, optional delta and deltaTone up|down|neutral

StatRow.description: Horizontal row of Stat children (use Stat refs)

KPIStrip.description: Compact strip of Stat children for desk card headers

Meter.signature: Meter(value: number, min?: number, max?: number, label?: string)
Meter.description: Meter gauge with value, min, max and optional label

Sparkline.description: Tiny SVG sparkline from a number array

Table.description: Column-oriented table: Table([Col(header, dataArray), ...]) — define each Col as its own statement

Col.description: Table column: header label and data array (positional rows); optional align left|center|right

ListItem.signature: ListItem(label: string, subtitle?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
ListItem.description: List row with label, optional subtitle and click action

Chip.description: Pill chip label; active highlights with accent

TagGroup.description: Wraps Badge/Chip children in a flex tag cluster

TimelineItem.signature: TimelineItem(title: string, time?: string, body?: string)
TimelineItem.description: Timeline entry: title, optional time and body text

TreeItem.signature: TreeItem(label: string, children?: any[], action?: ActionExpression)
TreeItem.description: Tree node; label, optional nested TreeItem children, optional action

FileRow.signature: FileRow(name: string, meta?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
FileRow.description: File list row; name, optional size/meta and action

Compare.description: Plan comparison: headers string array + CompareRow refs

CompareRow.description: Comparison table row; feature label and values string array (one per plan)

FeedItem.signature: FeedItem(author: string, body: string, time?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
FeedItem.description: Social/activity feed row; author, body, optional time and action

Comment.signature: Comment(author: string, body: string, time?: string)
Comment.description: Comment bubble; author, body, optional time

NotificationItem.signature: NotificationItem(title: string, body?: string, unread?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression)
NotificationItem.description: Notification row; title, body, optional unread flag and action

MediaCard.signature: MediaCard(src: string, title: string, meta?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
MediaCard.description: Media tile; image URL, title, optional meta and action

ProductCard.signature: ProductCard(title: string, price: string, image?: string, rating?: number, badge?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
ProductCard.description: Commerce card; title, price, optional image, rating, badge, action

Gallery.description: Image gallery grid from URL string array

Carousel.description: Simple carousel of child slides (Stack/Card/Image refs)

KanbanColumn.description: Kanban column; title and KanbanCard children

CalendarGrid.signature: CalendarGrid(label?: string, days: string[], highlights?: number[])
CalendarGrid.description: Month day grid; days string array length 28–42 (labels), optional highlight indexes

MapPlaceholder.description: Map stand-in with pin label (no live tiles); optional subtitle

Rating.description: Star rating display; value 0–5, optional count label

Price.signature: Price(amount: string, compareAt?: string, period?: string)
Price.description: Price display; amount string, optional compare-at and period

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string)
BarChart.description: Vertical bar chart from labels[] and values[]; optional title

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string)
LineChart.description: Line chart from labels[] and values[]; optional title

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string)
AreaChart.description: Filled area chart from labels[] and values[]; optional title

PieChart.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string)
PieChart.description: Pie chart from labels[] and numeric values[]; optional title

DonutChart.signature: DonutChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string)
DonutChart.description: Donut chart from labels[] and values[]; optional title

Form.signature: Form(name: string, fields: any[], buttons: any)
Form.description: Form container: name, fields[], buttons — NEVER nest Form in Form; pass explicit buttons

FormControl.signature: FormControl(label: string, field: any, hint?: string)
FormControl.description: Labeled field wrapper: label, field (Input|Select|…), optional hint — define each as its own statement

FieldRow.description: Responsive multi-column row of FormControl children

Input.signature: Input(name: string, value?: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, min?: number, max?: number, pattern?: string, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean})
Input.description: Text input bound by name; optional value, placeholder, type, rules

TextArea.signature: TextArea(name: string, value?: string, placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, min?: number, max?: number, pattern?: string, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean})
TextArea.description: Multi-line text field bound by name

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], value?: string, placeholder?: string)
Select.description: Dropdown bound by name; items are SelectItem refs

SelectItem.description: Select option with value and label

Checkbox.signature: Checkbox(name: string, label: string, value?: boolean)
Checkbox.description: Boolean checkbox bound by name with label

Switch.signature: Switch(name: string, label: string, value?: boolean)
Switch.description: Toggle switch bound by name with label

Slider.signature: Slider(name: string, value?: number, min?: number, max?: number, step?: number)
Slider.description: Numeric slider bound by name; min/max/step optional

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(name: string, options: Radio[], value?: string)
RadioGroup.description: Radio group bound by name; options are Radio refs

Radio.description: Single radio option: value and label (used inside RadioGroup)

SearchField.signature: SearchField(name: string, value?: string, placeholder?: string)
SearchField.description: Search input bound by name with magnifier affordance

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
Button.description: Action button; label, optional action, variant primary|secondary|ghost|danger, size sm|md|lg

IconButton.signature: IconButton(icon: string, action?: ActionExpression, label?: string)
IconButton.description: Square icon-only button; icon is a short emoji/symbol string, optional action

LinkButton.description: Text-style link button that triggers an action

MenuItem.description: Menu row with label and optional action

Toolbar.description: Compact action toolbar for Button/IconButton children

Alert.description: Inline alert; tone info|success|warning|danger, title, optional body

Toast.description: Transient toast message (render when visible via $var)

StatusDot.description: Status indicator; status ok|warn|err|busy|idle with optional label

Result.signature: Result(title: string, description?: string, tone?: "neutral" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info", actions?: any[])
Result.description: Centered success/empty/error result panel with title, description, optional actions children

ChatCard.description: Glass chat card wrapping message children and optional follow-ups / actions

MessageBubble.description: Chat bubble; role user|assistant and text body

FollowUpChips.description: Suggested follow-up prompts as clickable chips (each fires ToAssistant with its label)

StepList.description: Ordered agent/tool progress of Step refs

Step.description: Agent step row: title, optional description, status pending|active|done

ToolHeader.signature: ToolHeader(name: string, subtitle?: string, avatar?: string)
ToolHeader.description: Microtool card header: name, optional avatar URL/initials source, subtitle

MicrotoolResult.description: Pretty-printed JSON/text result from a microtool Query/Mutation

BindingHint.description: Shows an OpenUI $variable binding hint for desk authors (e.g. $search)
